channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: 2,000 ICE agents remain in Minnesota despite ‘drawdown’
item.description: A day after the Trump administration promised to remove 700 federal law enforcement officers from Minnesota, residents who were hopeful that the immigration crackdown might be waning said that they saw little sign of a withdrawal.

item.title: Gov. Green issues emergency proclamation as major storm approaches Hawaii
HPD motorcycle officer injured after being hit by suspected drunk driver
item.description: A Honolulu Police Department motorcycle officer was seriously injured after being hit by a suspected drunk driver on H-1 Freeway late Thursday night.

item.title: Google workers demand end to cloud services for immigration agencies
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO >> After federal immigration agents killed Alex Pretti in Minneapolis, Google employees lit up the company’s internal message boards with calls for the company to respond.

item.title: Dow closes above 50,000 for first time as AI frenzy returns
item.description: The Dow Jones Industrial Average blew past the historic 50,000 mark today and the S&P 500 ended sharply higher, as Nvidia and other chipmakers soared and Amazon tumbled after the cloud heavyweight forecast a sharp increase in spending on AI infrastructure.

item.title: Man, 38, seriously hurt after crashing car into tree in Waipahu
item.description: A 38-year-old man is in serious condition after a single-vehicle crash into light poles and a tree fronting Waipahu High School on Thursday, according to first responders.

item.title: Bitcoin rallies, tops $70,000 as risk assets stabilize
item.description: NEW YORK/LONDON >> Bitcoin climbed back above $70,000 today, after sinking to a 16-month low earlier, lifted by a sharp rebound in technology shares and precious metals following a global rout that had hammered a broad swathe of risk assets.

item.title: Kaiser workers launch war on AI over job loss, patient safety fears
item.description: Workers of one of the most powerful unions in California are forming an early front in the battle against artificial intelligence, warning it could take jobs and harm people’s health.

item.title: No. 3 Hawaii volleyball team adds 2 home matches against No. 8 BYU
item.description: The third-ranked Hawaii men’s volleyball team will host No. 8 Brigham Young for matches on Feb. 25 and 27, UH announced today.

item.title: Search for Nancy Guthrie in Arizona turns to new message
item.description: TUCSON, Ariz. >> Investigators searching through a sixth day for the elderly mother of U.S. television journalist Savannah Guthrie are examining a newly surfaced message in the presumed kidnapping, the FBI and Pima County Sheriff’s Department said today.
